members.name: layers
members.description: Visibility layers for this model, checked against a camera's modelLayers.

members.name: frustumCulling
members.description: Whether this model participates in frustum culling.

members.name: context
members.description: The Context3D used to render this model.

members.name: groups
members.description: The draw groups from a scene this object will be drawn on. Used to separate meshes in passes. When changing manually, set FoxRenderer.mustRebuildDrawGroups to true. See also addToDrawGroup(), removeFromDrawGroup(), setDrawGroupAt().

members.name: meshes
members.description: Meshes that will be rendered by this model, they inherit this model's transform. When changing manually, set FoxRenderer.mustRebuildDrawGroups to true. See also setMeshAt(), addMesh(), removeMesh(), removeMeshByIndex().

members.name: materialOverride
members.description: If set, this material will be applied to every mesh of this model when rendering.

members.name: materialOverlay
members.description: If set, this material will be applied over every mesh of this model, drawing the meshes again using this material.

members.name: skin
members.description: The skin associated with this mesh, assigned when added to a FoxArmature.

members.name: castShadows
members.description: Whether this model casts shadows (renders in the shadow pass).

members.name: castColoredShadows
members.description: If true, this model will cast colored shadows, useful for tinted translucent objects (stained glass, liquids, fabric). Requires castShadows to be true. Not implemented yet.

functions.name: renderMesh
functions.description: Draws a single mesh with the given shader.

functions.name: isInstanced
functions.description: Returns whether this model renders instanced (always false for FoxModel, true for FoxInstancedModel).

functions.name: addMesh
functions.description: Adds a mesh to this model and requests a draw group rebuild.

functions.name: setMeshAt
functions.description: Sets the mesh at the given index and requests a draw group rebuild.

functions.name: removeMesh
functions.description: Removes a mesh from this model.

functions.name: removeMeshByIndex
functions.description: Removes a mesh by its index.

functions.name: addToDrawGroup
functions.description: Adds a draw group index to this model.

functions.name: removeFromDrawGroup
functions.description: Removes a draw group index from this model.

functions.name: setDrawGroupAt
functions.description: Sets the draw group at the given index.

functions.name: getMaterial
functions.description: Shortcut to get a material from a mesh by index.

functions.name: setMaterial
functions.description: Shortcut to assign a material to a mesh by index.

functions.name: loadJSON
functions.description: Loads a FoxLite JSON model and assigns its meshes to this model.

functions.name: loadOBJ
functions.description: Loads an OBJ model and assigns its meshes to this model.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Destroys this model and clears its meshes.
